# Julia

This mod adds a Julia dev environment to code-server/openvscode-server, to be installed/updated during container start.

Add it to the `code-server` container with the environment variable

```
DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:code-server-julia
```

Several mods are separated by `|`, for example
`DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:code-server-julia|ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:universal-tshoot`. Recreate the container to
apply the change.

## Versions

The mod packages [upstream](https://julialang.org/) (`json https://api.github.com/repos/JuliaLang/julia/releases`). The
control plane checks it every hour and rebuilds the mod when a new version comes out; each build is also tagged
with its version, so `ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:code-server-julia-<version>` pins one.

## Details

**This mod no longer supports arm32v7 due to upstream binaries no longer guaranteed to be available on it per [this post](https://discourse.julialang.org/t/is-the-linux-armv7l-binary-deprecated/85924/2).**

By default, the latest stable version of Julia will be installed. If you'd like to install a different version, you can specify the version as a tag, from a list of published tags: https://hub.docker.com/r/linuxserver/mods/tags?page=1&name=code-server-julia (ie. `DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:code-server-julia-1.8.0`).

The mod's page on the website: https://linuxserver-playground.github.io/site/mods/code-server-julia/
